claim: Reduce time spent locked out by the guard while still hard-stopping near -20%.
causal_mechanism: The audit shows the guard activated multiple times and the champion already sat close to the -20% limit; a dynamic resume threshold may recover participation without losing drawdown control.
expected_effect: Reduce time spent locked out by the guard while still hard-stopping near -20%.
falsification_rule: Reject if DD breaks -20, CAGR fails to beat SPY, or the guard tweak adds no measurable improvement vs parent DD20.

empirical_basis.reason: Guard activations and partial rebalances suggest the current lockout is active enough to matter.

metadata.expected_effect: Resume at 14% DD with reduced exposure 30% while preserving the -20% hard cap.
metadata.why_this_should_help: The guard was active several times and caused partial rebalances; a dynamic guard should restore participation when DD is still under control.
metadata.success_rule: max_drawdown_pct no worse than -20; CAGR must exceed SPY; and one parent DD20 metric must improve materially.
metadata.rejection_rule: Reject if DD < -20, CAGR <= SPY, or no parent metric improves materially.

risk_of_overfit: Controlled: evidence-driven and limited to 12 variants.
novelty_reason: Derived directly from the latest DD20 champion audit and bad-period evidence.
why_not_duplicate: Each variant changes one controlled lever within guardrail_dynamic rather than making random parameter noise.
